evals.name: products-feature
evals.prompt: im building a flutter app with riverpod 3, go_router, dio and freezed (build_runner is set up). add a 'products' feature for me: a list screen that loads from GET /products?page=N (the api returns { data: [...], last_page: N }), with pull to refresh and load more when i scroll to the bottom, plus a details screen at /products/:id that loads GET /products/:id. a product has id, name, price, image_url and description. write all the files i need.
evals.expected_output: Source files for a products feature (model, API service, repository, view models, list and details screens, routes) that follow the house architecture and Riverpod rules.
expectations: HTTP calls live in a service class that is separate from the repository, and only that service uses Dio
A repository sits between the view models and the service and is provided through a Riverpod provider
The product model is an immutable Freezed class with JSON support
The list view model's build() performs the first fetch and returns or throws; it does not assign state or call AsyncValue.guard inside build
No screen starts a data load from initState
Load-more keeps the products already loaded when the next page fails (the list is not replaced by a loading or error state)
The details screen gets its data from a family provider keyed by the product id, not from a shared selected-product provider
Pull-to-refresh uses RefreshIndicator and re-runs the provider (ref.refresh or invalidate)
The list screen renders loading, error and data states from AsyncValue
Navigation to details puts the id in the path (/products/:id) through go_router, not an object in extra
Failures surface as a typed app exception thrown by the data layer; nothing returns null to signal failure
Screen-level providers are auto-dispose
User-visible strings come from generated localizations, not string literals
Files follow the layered layout: data/services, data/repositories, domain/models and ui/features/products with view models and views

evals.name: login-form
evals.prompt: need a login screen for my flutter app (riverpod + go_router + dio). email and password, calls POST /auth/login which returns { access_token, refresh_token }. if the server returns 422 with field errors like { errors: { email: ['...'] } } show them under the right field. after login the user should land on the home screen. write the screen and whatever sits behind it.
evals.expected_output: A login form with validation, an action controller, token storage and session handling, with navigation driven by the router's redirect.
expectations: The form key is a field of the State class and validation runs through Form and TextFormField validators
Submitting goes through a Riverpod Notifier whose state is an AsyncValue; the text being typed is not stored in a provider
The submit button is disabled or shows progress while the request is running
422 field errors from the server are shown under the matching field and are cleared when the user edits that field
Tokens are stored with flutter_secure_storage, not SharedPreferences
After a successful login the screen does not navigate itself; the session state changes and the router's redirect sends the user to home
TextEditingControllers are disposed
Email and password fields set keyboard type, text input action and autofill hints, and the password is obscured
The Dio call lives in a service or repository; the widget and the controller do not use Dio directly
The data layer throws a typed exception for failures, including the 422 case, instead of returning null or leaking DioException to the UI
User-visible strings come from generated localizations, not string literals
mounted is checked after awaits before context, ref or state is used again

evals.name: review-orders
evals.prompt: can you review these two files from our flutter app? we're on riverpod 3 and go_router. two bugs we keep seeing: when the api fails the orders screen just shows an empty list instead of an error, and when load more runs the whole list disappears and flashes. tell me what's wrong and how to fix it.
evals.expected_output: A review that explains both reported bugs, lists the other rule violations in the two files, and shows corrected code.
expectations: Explains the empty-list bug: the error is caught inside the build path and `state.value ?? []` turns it into an empty list
Explains the flash on load more: loadMore replaces the whole state with loading, and says to keep the list and handle a failed page separately
Says build should do the fetch itself and return or throw, with no state assignment or AsyncValue.guard inside it
Flags the load started from initState
Flags ref.read in the widget's build and says to use ref.watch
Flags the repository catching errors and returning null, and says it should throw
Flags the Dio instance created inside the repository
Flags selectedOrderProvider or passing the order in extra, and recommends an id in the route with a provider keyed by id
Flags hard-coded UI strings, colours or text styles
Flags the provider not being auto-dispose or the mutable _page field kept outside the state
Provides corrected code for the controller
Findings are ordered by severity and tied to the two symptoms the user reported
